title: It has helped me tremendously
body: This app, does its job. It is as simple as that. But if you do want to improve it, i have but one suggestion. You can see that some other apps have motivating systems. They turn this into a game, making your battle slightly easier. However all of them also cost money, which i can only assume means this system is hard to implement. And just a side-note; iPad version please. It probably doesn’t bother anyone tbh. But i think it would be better if you were to implement it. Anyway, ty. This app has helped me.
